newsitem.title: USA: Valero refinances Corpus Christi bonds.
newsitem.headline: Valero refinances Corpus Christi bonds.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp said the refinancing of the industrial revenue bonds financing its Corpus Christi, Texas, refinery will reduce the company's interest costs.
The company said $98.5 million of Revenue Refunding Bonds were issued Wednesday by the Industrial Development Corporation of the Port of Corpus Christi.
The bond proceeds are being loaned to Valero Refining and Marketing Co, a Valero Energy subsidiary, and credit enhancement is being provided through a letter of credit issued by the Bank of Montreal.
The bonds were issued to refinance $98.5 million principal amount bonds issued in 1987, for which Valero Energy served as the guarantor.

In connection with the refinancing, both the Valero Energy guarantee, as well as a deed of trust and security agreement covering Valero Refining and Marketing's Corpus Christi refinery, are being released.
"As a result of this refinancing, the company will receive significant benefit from the substantially lower interest rates," said Chief Financial Officer Ed Benninger.
"In addition, the credit enhancement provided by the Bank of Montreal under Valero's principal bank credit facility demonstrates the bank group's confidence in Valero's favorable outlook."
